name: edit_google_doc
description: Edit a Google Docs document using a diff-style approach. The primary operation is 'diff': provide a find block (exact text to locate) and a replace_with block (what to put in its place). The tool finds all occurrences of the search block in the document — if exactly one match is found it applies the edit; if zero matches are found it returns an error telling you to re-read the document; if two or more matches are found it returns an AMBIGUOUS error with expanded context around each match site so you can widen the find block to make it unique, then retry. Also supports 'append' to add text to the document end.

inputs.name: document_id
inputs.description: Google Docs document ID (from the document URL).

inputs.name: operation
inputs.description: Operation to perform. One of: diff, append.

inputs.name: find
inputs.description: For diff: the exact text block to locate and replace. Must match the document character-for-character including whitespace and newlines. Include enough surrounding lines to uniquely identify the location — if the block appears more than once, the tool returns an AMBIGUOUS error with context around each site so you can extend the block and retry.

inputs.name: replace_with
inputs.description: For diff: the replacement text. Should include any existing lines you want to keep plus the new content. May be empty string to delete the found block.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: For append: the text to add to the end of the document.

inputs.name: ensure_newline
inputs.description: For append: prepend a newline before the appended text if the document does not already end with one (default true).

outputs.description: Human-readable confirmation of the edit, or error description.
For diff: number of replacements applied (always 1 on success).
For AMBIGUOUS error: how many locations the find block matched.
For AMBIGUOUS error: [{offset, context}] — character offset and surrounding text for each match site. Use these to extend the find block until it is unique.

arguments_prompt:
DIFF WORKFLOW:
1. Call get_google_doc to read the current document text.
2. Identify the exact block of text to replace (find). Include enough surrounding lines
   (typically 2-4 lines before and after the change point) so the block is unique.
3. Build replace_with: the full replacement — keep any existing lines you want plus add new content.
4. Call edit_google_doc with operation=diff.

Error handling:
- NO_MATCH: your find block doesn't match. Re-read the document and correct it.
- AMBIGUOUS: find matched multiple locations. The error includes context excerpts around
  each site. Extend the find block using those excerpts until it is unique, then retry.

Arguments:
  document_id (required): Google Docs ID.
  operation (required): diff | append.

  For diff:
    find (required): exact text to locate (include surrounding context lines for uniqueness).
    replace_with: replacement text (empty string = delete the found block).

  For append:
    text (required): text to add at the end.
    ensure_newline: true/false (default true).

  account_id: optional (e.g. "google_user_primary").

EXAMPLE — adding items to a Ralphs section:
  find: "- milk\n- eggs"
  replace_with: "- milk\n- eggs\n- butter\n- bread"
  (The find block anchors to the existing end of the list; replace_with keeps existing items and appends new ones.)
